subject: MAP: security acceptance, SOC 2 / SIG / DPA timeline and retention options
content:
From: Anita Rao <anita@fintrust.com>

Cc: Marcus Lee <security@fintrust.com>
Date: Sun, 18 May 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: security acceptance, SOC 2 / SIG / DPA timeline and retention options

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team liked the latency numbers and the rollout flexibility. Before we commit to the evaluation MAP we need to confirm the security gates that will be part of our acceptance criteria. High-level asks: SOC 2 scope and evidence timing, SIG/CAIQ responses, DPA redline status, and concrete data retention options (EU residency requirement and deletion API availability).

Can you share a proposed MAP with these checkpoints and an estimated close timeline? Our legal team also wants to understand what data buckets are covered under the DPA (logs vs prompts vs embeddings) and any escape hatches for production cutover.

Best,
Anita Rao
Head of Infrastructure Security
FinTrust Bank

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: Anita Rao <anita@fintrust.com>
Cc: Marcus Lee <security@fintrust.com>
Date: Mon, 19 May 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: security acceptance, SOC 2 / SIG / DPA timeline and retention options

Hi Anita — thanks for the clear list. 

Attached is a first-pass MAP (FinTrust_MAP_v1.xlsx) that maps evaluation milestones to security/compliance gates. Quick summary here:

- SOC 2: we can provide our SOC 2 Type II report and an evidence pack within 3 business days of your request. For controls you want in-scope (data handling, encryption at rest/in-transit, access controls), we’ve noted expected artifacts in the MAP.
- SIG/CAIQ: we’ve completed the CAIQ matrix and attached our responses (SIG-CAIQ_Responses.xlsx). We can walk the questionnaire with your security team in a 60-minute call.
- DPA: we maintain a standard DPA; legal redlines are expected to be a 2–3 day review for non-substantive items. For carve-outs (data residency, escrow, or subprocessing) we’ll need negotiation time — included in the timeline. A draft redline is attached (DPA_redline_kp.docx).
- Data retention: options we support out of the box: 30 days, 90 days, 365 days. EU residency is available for production workloads; for evaluation we can stage data in eu-central-1 on request. We also expose a deletion API and an export endpoint for audit.

Proposed close timeline (high level):
- Week 0: MAP baseline agreed + kickoff call
- Week 1: Evidence pack & SOC 2 excerpt delivered; SIG questionnaire session
- Week 2: DPA redline loop + legal alignment
- Week 3: Staging evaluation + security sign-off
- Week 4: Production go/no-go and commercial close

I realize banking customers sometimes require longer retention or escrow options — if FinTrust needs 7-year logs or HSM escrow for keys, flag that and we’ll route to our security/product teams for an enterprise carve-out.

I’ll loop in Prio and Neha internally to finalize the artifacts and estimated delivery dates.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Enterprise Sales Lead
Redwood Inference
attachments: FinTrust_MAP_v1.xlsx; Redwood_SOC2-excerpt.pdf; SIG-CAIQ_Responses.xlsx; DPA_redline_kp.docx

On Tue, May 20, 2025 at 10:12 AM priyom_das@redwood.ai wrote:
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 20 May 2025 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: MAP: security acceptance, SOC 2 / SIG / DPA timeline and retention options

Kim — SOC 2 excerpt and control mapping (data handling, encryption, logging, IAM) availability: I can package the artifacts by end of day Wednesday. SIG spreadsheet is current; I’ll mark a couple of outstanding items where engineering needs to confirm behavior for streaming logs vs stored embeddings.

Deletion API: behavior is asynchronous for cached inference prefixes (ttl-based) — we guarantee background deletion propagation within 48 hours for indexes/embeddings and within 24 hours for tokens/logs removal requests. For EU residency, staging can be pinned to eu-central-1 for the evaluation; production residency is supported via Private deployment or region selection.

If FinTrust needs >365 day retention we should flag this as an enterprise carve-out (legal + product).

Priyom
Principal, Solutions Engineering

From: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai

Date: Wed, 21 May 2025 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: MAP: security acceptance, SOC 2 / SIG / DPA timeline and retention options

Agree with Priyom. Legal note on DPA: our standard DPA covers prompts and embeddings as "Customer Data"; logs are classified as "Operational Data" with separate retention options. We can accept a narrow carve: agree to delete prompts/embeddings on request and provide an export for logs with a separate retention SLA. Also confirm that the DPA redline we sent flags processor sub-processors list and we can provide completed CAIQ when signature is close.

I recommend we propose a 3-week MAP (as Kim suggested) but explicitly call out the legal review window and any enterprise carve-outs. I can take point on the DPA responses and run redline with legal on Thursday morning.

Neha
Sr. Counsel, Privacy & Security

Anita — following up with a concise MAP and timeline based on internal confirmations. Key points below and I attached the MAP + artifacts.

1) Evidence & questionnaires
   - SOC 2 Type II excerpt and control mapping: attached (Redwood_SOC2-excerpt.pdf). Delivery: immediate (today).
   - SIG/CAIQ: attached responses and we can run a 60-minute walkthrough next Tue 2025-05-27.

2) DPA & legal
   - Draft redline attached (DPA_redline_kp.docx). Neha will run legal review; expect a 48–72 hour turnaround for non-substantive items. For enterprise carve-outs (7-year retention or key escrow) expect additional product/legal time.

3) Data residency & retention
   - Evaluation staging: we can pin to EU region (eu-central-1) on request.
   - Retention presets: 30 / 90 / 365 days for Customer Data. Deletion API: deletion requests enacted within 24–48 hours depending on object type; background propagation guarantees documented in MAP.

4) Proposed MAP timeline (binding for evaluation phase)
   - Day 0 (kickoff): agree MAP + sign mutual action items
   - Day 3: SOC 2 excerpt + SIG responses delivered
   - Day 7–10: Legal DPA loop closed for standard redlines
   - Day 14–21: Staging evaluation complete + security sign-off
   - Day 21–28: Production-ready decision and commercial close

Next steps: if that timeline works, can we schedule the SIG walkthrough for Tue 2025-05-27 at 10:00 AM CET (or Tue 2025-05-27 01:00 AM PDT)? Also confirm if FinTrust wants retention presets changed for evaluation (e.g., pin to 90 days) and whether logs must remain in EU for the evaluation period.

Thanks — looking forward to closing this quickly.

Best,
Kimberly Park
